lines.text: Fordite is jewelry made from car paint.
lines.say: FOR-dyte is jewelry made from car paint.

lines.text: It is hardened paint that built up in old car factories.
Spray that missed the car landed on the racks and piled up.
Layer upon layer, it baked again and again in the ovens.
Workers noticed the colors and began cutting and polishing chunks.
Each layer is a color popular when that car was sprayed.
The boldest metallic colors come from the 1960s and 1970s.
lines.say: The boldest metallic colors come from the nineteen sixties and nineteen seventies.

lines.text: A flat cut shows stripes, but cutting into a bump shows bullseyes.
It is shaped into smooth cabochons and set in silver.
lines.say: It is shaped into smooth KAB-uh-shonz and set in silver.

lines.text: Hand spraying ended by the 1980s, so the old supply is limited.
lines.say: Hand spraying ended by the nineteen eighties, so the old supply is limited.

post.caption: Fordite is jewelry made from car paint. It is hardened paint that built up in old car factories. Spray that missed the car landed on the racks and piled up. Layer upon layer, it baked again and again in the ovens. Workers noticed the colors and began cutting and polishing chunks. Each layer is a color popular when that car was sprayed. The boldest metallic colors come from the 1960s and 1970s. A flat cut shows stripes, but cutting into a bump shows bullseyes. It is shaped into smooth cabochons and set in silver. Hand spraying ended by the 1980s, so the old supply is limited.
